_note: Caravel = caravel-lite 2024.09.12-1 (5593d992). clock pad: verilog/rtl/caravel.v line 57 (CMOS core clock input, not a crystal), chip_io.v line 288; pad positions: def/chip_io.def COMPONENTS (clock_pad, resetb_pad on the bottom edge; user1_vccd_lvclamp_pad lines 17057-17058, user1_vssd_lvclamp_pad lines 16653-16654, right edge). clock_core -> caravel_clocking ext_clk and digital_pll osc: caravel_core.v lines 525, 546. Power-up: housekeeping.v lines 1040-1041 pll_ena <= 0, pll_bypass <= 1; pll_bypass = ext_clk_sel (caravel_core.v lines 524, 594); caravel_clocking.v lines 93-95 core_clk = ext_clk until use_pll_second, then pll_clk_divided (clock_div, lines 70-79; divider sel reset 3'b010 'divide-by-2', housekeeping.v line 1036). PLL registers 0x08/0x09/0x11/0x12: housekeeping.v lines 1097-1131. core_clk -> caravel_clk -> management SoC (caravel_core.v lines 281, 532) and mgmt_protect; user_clock = caravel_clk & mprj_logic1[1], user_clock2 = caravel_clk2 & mprj_logic1[2], user_reset = ~caravel_rstn & mprj_logic1[0] (mgmt_protect.v lines 232-234); mprj_logic1 = vccd1 logic high (mgmt_protect.v lines 122-128); wb_clk_i / wb_rst_i / user_clock2 of mprj: caravel_core.v lines 408-410, 443-444, 468. resetb: XRES pad with glitch filter, pull-up enabled (chip_io.v lines 301-304, 318); xres_buf 3.3 V -> 1.8 V (caravel_core.v lines 1390-1399, xres_buf.v lines 16-19); simple_por about 15 ms (simple_por.v lines 35-45); resetb_async = porb & resetb & !ext_reset (caravel_clocking.v line 51); 3-bit delay on negedge core_clk, resetb_sync high on the 3rd falling edge (lines 101-112); ext_reset = housekeeping reset register 0x0b (housekeeping.v lines 1043, 1107-1108). This design: CLOCK_PORT wb_clk_i, CLOCK_PERIOD 44 (pnr/user_project_wrapper/config.json lines 53-55); soc_top clk = wb_clk_i, resetn = ~wb_rst_i, vccd1 / vssd1 (rtl/caravel/user_project_wrapper.v lines 125-129); user_clock2 unused (line 175). Supply: vccd1 / vssd1 one pad each, right edge, about 2.2 mm apart; Caravel's 5 um met4 ring; met3 bridges of manual_power_connections.lef on the left and right sides of the wrapper ring only, 54 left / 53 right per net (.claude/skills/caravel-user-project-integration/SKILL.md rule 3 line 27; pnr/user_project_wrapper/caravel_pwr/README.md lines 13, 20; ADR-0019 line 82). IR from the pads 19.56 mV, limit 20 mV (README.md line 56).
